operating_contract.autonomy: Ordinary bounded repository implementation, normal CI/browser acceptance and roadmap-required no-write evidence work are standing-preapproved under AGENTS.md. Do not ask for routine Actions approval.
operating_contract.barbecue_scope: Conventional above-ground barbecue/grill only. Charcoal, gas, kettle, pellet and conventional smoker/barbecue apparatus are in scope. Underground/earth-oven, buried, ash/ember-buried, non-grill fire-pit/campfire and open-hearth techniques are excluded from V1.
operating_contract.barbecue_source_rule: Each leaf targets five independent admission-qualified references. World-champion/competition queries run first; title wording alone never qualifies a source. Specialist/educator fallback is allowed only when fewer than five championship-level qualified sources are available. Never lower the source gate to reach five.
operating_contract.barbecue_storage: Durable state may retain references/IDs, creator/channel identity, qualification/provenance metadata, project-authored normalized observations, derived ranges/alternatives, safety state and compact programme state. No transcripts, copied recipe prose/instructions, images, downloaded video/audio or bulk raw API payload history.
operating_contract.barbecue_safety: Practitioner videos are not food-safety authority. Safety constraints must come from appropriate safety authorities.
